mission_link: The product's v1.1 multi-view map contract (legal-distance state/legal-distance.json and ACCEPTED evaluation state/evaluation.json) makes the citation-heritage view a DENSE-embedding complementary mode, justified by the claim that dense center_projected embeddings beat TF-IDF citation-based representations on citation-heritage AUC. If that claim is a metric artifact, the product contract changes (dense is not needed for citation heritage; TF-IDF citation representation already covers it).
question: Is the legal-distance accepted claim 'dense center_projected embeddings recover citation heritage better than TF-IDF citation-based (AUC 0.77-0.85 vs 0.71-0.74)' a valid, non-artifactual result on the frozen citation-heritage benchmark?

accepted_claim_under_test.text: Dense multilingual-e5 embeddings RECOVER citation heritage at scale (AUC 0.79-0.85 at 21-22yr) BETTER than TF-IDF citation-based (AUC 0.71-0.74).

threats_preregistered.T1_self_pairs: citation_pairs_174k.json positive_pairs contains 174/1020 (17.1%) pairs of the form (d,d). Cosine similarity of (d,d) is exactly 1.0 for EVERY representation, which mechanically inflates positive scores and AUC. Any claim must be recomputed after removing self-pairs.
threats_preregistered.T2_pair_set_mismatch: The dense citation-heritage runs filter positive/negative pairs to decisions present in the dense year-checkpoints (e.g. 100 pairs at 2000-2020, 344 at 2000-2021, 730 at 2000-2023), while the TF-IDF citation-heritage runs evaluate all 1020 pairs. dense vs TF-IDF are therefore measured on DIFFERENT pair sets. A fair comparison must evaluate all representations on the IDENTICAL decision-matched pair set.
threats_preregistered.T3_subset_selection: Because the citation graph is concentrated in recent years, filtering to early checkpoints selects a small, year-biased pair sample. Statistical uncertainty must be reported (bootstrap).

dense: dense_cp64 (PCA-64 fitted on the assembled cp subset + L2, matching the original pipeline)
tfidf: cited_decisions_tfidf (AUC reference best of the citation family)

fixed_pair_sets.ORIG: evaluation/results/174k_citation_heritage/citation_pairs_174k.json (1020 pos / 1020 neg; coverage 174 decisions in graph)
fixed_pair_sets.FULL: /tmp/lex_accepted/evaluation/evaluation/results/174k_citation_heritage/citation_pairs_174k_full.json (137314 pos / 137314 neg; 5031 decisions in graph) used as a high-power secondary set
fixed_pair_sets.P_matched: ORIG pairs where BOTH decisions have a dense 2000-2023 embedding (primary fair comparison set)
fixed_pair_sets.no_self: the respective pair set with (d,d) pairs removed from positives and negatives

metric: AUC-ROC via Mann-Whitney U with average ranks; cosine similarity as the decision score

success_rule_frozen.claim_survives: AUC(dense_cp64) - max(AUC(tfidf_citation_family)) >= +0.02 on the IDENTICAL P_matched + no_self pair set.
success_rule_frozen.self_pair_inflation_reported: Delta AUC caused by removing self-pairs, per representation
success_rule_frozen.uncertainty: 2000-resample bootstrap 95% CI on the dense-minus-best-TFIDF AUC margin (seed 42)

decision_unlocked.if_survives: Keep dense citation-heritage as a valid complementary mode; proceed to 174k integration contract.
decision_unlocked.if_falsified: Retract citation_heritage_dense_superiority from ACCEPTED legal-distance state; the product citation-heritage view does NOT require dense embeddings; update product contract to TF-IDF citation heritage (AUC ~0.73-0.74) and remove the 'dense superior' justification.

note: This is an independent falsification audit of a claim already RETRACTED by the ACCEPTED evaluation lane (evaluation/state/evaluation.json: citation_heritage_view status DENSE_NOT_EMPIRICALLY_VALIDATED, 'Previous claims of AUC 0.7667-0.8182 were from partial/insufficient runs and are retracted'). The legal-distance lane state still carries the claim as ACCEPTED. This audit resolves the cross-lane contradiction with executable evidence.
